adobe_api.status: Published execute-actions brush resources and brush/path action descriptors remain unsupported. Existing routes continue to reject unqualified fields/descriptors. No dedicated freehand endpoint is present in the pinned contract. ABR transport support does not imply Firefly job compatibility.
adobe_api.next: Qualify real brush/path descriptors and job-local ABR resource binding, preserving asynchronous job semantics. Do not invent descriptor shapes from the UXP method signature.

limitations: No byte-identical Photoshop rasterization claim; procedural texture, antialias/mipmapping and high-depth/HDR brush precision need independent qualification.
Generated bristle stamp is not a physical bristle/wet-media simulation; Mixer Brush is next.
Complete ABR versions/fields, brush organizational UI details and large-file API transfers remain open. Unsupported fields are reported; missing samples/patterns reject affected presets.
Adobe execute-actions brush resources and descriptors are not implemented in this increment. Full B01 acceptance remains open.
Native event capture exists but physical tablet, live Photoshop and macOS14/Intel/macOS26 platform checks remain unqualified.
API inline preset file limits are narrower than desktop; imported files do not silently truncate.
Preview uses completed full-document snapshots, coalescing pointer events to avoid starvation; incremental dirty-region performance remains open.
Painting on nonraster content currently rejects; current Adobe documentation describes automatic creation of a transparent paint layer. Carry this major workflow dependency into B02.
next: B02 missing major painting tools: Pencil, Mixer Brush, Color Replacement, Pattern Stamp, Background Eraser and Magic Eraser, each with shared APIs/history and focused tests. Exact numerical/cosmetic refinements stay deferred.
